`PRODUCT_VERSION` 1.5.0 · `CONTRACT_VERSION` 4.11.0

1.5.0 lets you see every sequence as a graph and watch a run move through it live.

### Added

- **Sequences can be viewed as a graph.** A new Graph tab on each sequence lays out its steps, and you can collapse a group of steps to keep a large sequence readable.
- **You can watch a run live as a graph** from the run panel. When the graph can't be shown for a run, the app tells you why.
- **You choose the sequence when you dispatch an idea**, so an idea is no longer limited to one kind of run.

### Changed

- **Deputy sends work back at most three times by default**, and you can set a different limit for each project.
- **Fewer memories are flagged as conflicting**, and a new memory replaces an older one automatically only when it clearly supersedes it. Memories replaced before 1.4.3 are now decided again under the current rule.

### Fixed

- **The run panel keeps updating after a failed refresh** and no longer stalls on the last error.
- **Using Codex no longer leaves extra background processes running.**
- **Deputy's settlement question now takes a whole number as its answer.**
